attchmntText: Heranba Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Heranba Industries Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in Financial Express and Mumbai Lakshadweep newspapers. The announcement includes a supplementary advertisement from Purity Flexpack Limited. This supplement provides a QR code for financial results that were inadvertently omitted from an earlier publication dated November 9, 2026. The financial results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on November 7, 2026. The document also contains a sale intimation and notice from HDFC Bank Limited. This notice informs borrowers of the sale of securities pledged to the bank due to persistent default. The sale is scheduled to occur on or after November 17, 2026.

attchmntText: Heranba Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Board Comments'.
voiceSummary: Heranba Industries Limited submitted board comments regarding a fine of Rs. 35,400 levied by the Exchange for delayed submission of financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The Board reviewed the matter on November 07, 2026. The Board noted the delay resulted from implementing a new ERP system requiring extensive data validation. The Company had proactively informed the Exchanges of the postponement. The Board observed the delay was not deliberate. The Company has paid the fine. The Board advised management to ensure timely financial closing and strict adherence to regulatory timelines in the future.

attchmntText: Heranba Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Rajib Mukhopadhyay as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. January 01, 2027.
voiceSummary: Heranba Industries Limited appointed Mr. Rajib Mukhopadhyay as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel. The Board of Directors approved this appointment during its meeting held on November 07, 2026. Mr. Mukhopadhyay will assume charge effective January 01, 2027. He holds over 20 years of experience in finance leadership roles across manufacturing, textile, consulting, IT, and sports entertainment sectors. Prior to this role, he served as CFO at Sutlej Textiles and Indofil Industries Limited. He is a Chartered Accountant from ICAI and completed an Advanced Management Programme at Harvard Business School. This disclosure is submitted pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Heranba Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Heranba Industries Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved the appointment of Mr. Rajib Mukhopadhyay as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel, effective January 01, 2027. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 697.58 crores. Profit before tax stood at 50.13 crores, with profit after tax at 36.55 crores. Basic earnings per share were 9.14 rupees. The Board meeting was held on November 07, 2026. The financial results have been reviewed by N V C & Associates LLP, who issued an unmodified report.
